name: Planar Half-Elf
body:
Note Generally more powerful than their Material Plane counterparts, this humanoid variant are more likely be encountered as NPCs but may occasionally be allowed as player characters for high-powered campaigns.

Exceedingly rare, planar half-elves gravitate to planar hubs and other regions where they can put their skills to use as envoys and jack-of-all-trades.

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 to Charisma and +2 to any one other ability score of your choice. This trait alters ability scores.
Languages You begin play speaking Celestial, Common, and Elven. If you have a 23 high Intelligence score, you can choose from any language except for secret languages. This trait alters languages.
Spell-Like Abilities You can use cultural adaptation, heightened awareness, and light once each per day as spell-like abilities, using your character level as the caster level and Charisma as your casting ability.

Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum
